description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), grants [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Fickle Faerie] and [Fickle Aid Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Fickle Faerie
description.text: Black Magic and Dancer abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for Black Magic and Dancer abilities, grants [HP Stock (1500)] to all allies after using Black Magic or Dancer abilities

description.name: HP Stock (1500)
description.text: Automatically restores HP, up to 1500 HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle

description.name: Fickle Aid Follow-Up
description.text: Grants [Weakness +50% Boost 1] to all allies after using two Black Magic or Dancer abilities

description.name: Weakness +50% Boost 1
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 50% when exploiting elemental weaknesses
